identity.family: 500 SurroundCook with SteamBake Catalytic Built-in Oven

raw_facts.label: Catalytic cleaning:
raw_facts.value: A special oven coating lets you burn away grease and fat by running the oven at a high temperature.

raw_facts.label: SteamBake: Using a burst of steam to create humidity, to give the perfect rise, this oven is perfect for the bakers amongst us.
Temperature probe
raw_facts.value: Once the selected temperature has been reached the oven will automatically switch off, ensuring perfect cooking results.

raw_facts.label: Cooling fan
raw_facts.value: The cooling fan starts automatically when the oven is switched on. It cools the electronic components and the external parts of the oven.

raw_facts.label: Fan controlled defrosting: Great for delicate items like cream cakes, by using room-temperature air to defrost food in half the time.
LED digital display
raw_facts.value: Clear information at a glance with the LED display.

raw_facts.label: Isofront® plus triple glazed doors with a heat reflective coating.
Retractable controls
raw_facts.value: For a flush finish and easy cleaning.

raw_facts.label: Child lock: Oven controls can be locked to prevent misuse, providing safety and peace of mind.
Turbo grilling
raw_facts.value: Achieve the ideal balance of a crispy exterior and juicy interior when roasting a meat joint.

raw_facts.label: Functions (Main Oven)
raw_facts.value: Frozen foods, Bottom heat, Conventional/Traditional cooking, Grilling, Moist fan baking, Pizza setting, Steam bake, True fan cooking, Turbo grilling
